test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Eight friends, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, and Q are sitting around a round table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). K is an immediate neighbour of both Q and M. N is an immediate neighbour of both P and J. L is sitting immediately right to J. K is sitting at the immediate left of Q and is second to the right of O.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of M?
solution: Given: Eight friends, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, and Q are sitting around a round table facing the centre 1) K is sitting at the immediate left of Q and is second to the right of O. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fa7e7e08f9d997766a9de9ed543b2cac7ea7a39e820cbb07c5367070dc07722.png] 2) K is an immediate neighbour of both Q and M.
